reason: Free one-pager on my own business and no meeting to get it, that costs me nothing but a read on Monday. The price is written down before he starts and I only pay the balance if it passes the test, so the risk sits on his side, not mine.
objection: I still do not know who in town used him and how it went. Nobody I trust has vouched for him yet, and the last thing I need is another monthly contract I cannot get out of.
would_change_my_mind: One name I actually know, a fellow owner in the trades or a practice manager around here, who says he did what he promised and handed it over clean.
